description: L-Tryptophan displays a strong aromatic absorption band at ~219 nm (ε ~33000, ¹Bᵇ π→π* transition of the indole ring), and a characteristic near-UV band at 278 nm (ε ~5600, ¹Lₐ π→π*) with a vibronic shoulder near 288 nm. The 278 nm band is used for protein A280 quantification.
transition: π→π* (¹Lₐ at 278 nm; ¹Bᵇ at 219 nm) of the indole chromophore
clinicalNote: The 278 nm band (ε ~5540 per residue) is the primary basis for A280 protein concentration determination in biochemistry and biopharmaceutical QC. Tryptophan and tyrosine account for >95% of protein UV absorption at 280 nm.

sources.purpose: ε(278 nm) = 5540 per tryptophan residue in native proteins (Mach et al., Anal Biochem 1992)
